page: Amazon Web Services c6gd.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by custom 64-bit ARMv8 AWS Graviton (Neoverse-N1) processors. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz with no hyperthreading. The memory configuration provides 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. Storage is bundled with 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, and the instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 48571.1 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11706.0. Single-core performance is relatively weaker, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 958.0 and a weak rating in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. However, multi-threaded operations perform in the average tier, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaching 64.62 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is strong for small cached blocks at 1894.03 GB/sec but drops to 173.34 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, reflecting a weak overall Passmark memory score of 1830.4.

Given its dedicated ARM cores, local NVMe SSD storage, and average multi-core performance, the c6gd.8xlarge is highly cost-efficient for scale-out, multi-threaded workloads that require fast local scratch space. It is well-suited for applications such as software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It is less optimal for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive workloads due to its lower memory-to-core ratio and weaker single-core benchmark results.

It features 64.0 GB of system memory, 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, this instance delivers balanced multi-core performance, as evidenced by average ratings in multi-threaded benchmarks like stress-ng and Geekbench. While single-core performance and memory bandwidth for large blocks are relatively weak, its dedicated core allocation and high-speed local storage make it highly efficient for multi-threaded workloads. The c6gd.8xlarge is suited for software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks that benefit from fast local storage and dedicated ARM architecture.
